column1: # Burmese OCR spelling normalization rules (regex + substring passes).
# Ported from a JS post-processing script. 128 raw rules
# collapsed to 90 unique rules, grouped by category. Rules within
# a category run in their original source order; categories run dedup ->
# char-class -> lookaround -> literal (independence assumed: each is a
# global replace_all over the current text; none of the literal/char-class
#   - Trailing whitespace in a pattern or replacement IS significant
#     (one rule intentionally matches a trailing space).
# Conflict note: source had /ရယ်ရွင်/ -> ရယ်ရွှင်ခြင်း AND -> ရယ်ရွှင်;
# kept the shorter form (ရယ်ရွှင်) — the -ခြင်း gerund would corrupt
# non-gerund contexts under a global substring replace.
က္[ဃဆဏတထဘယလသဟ]
က္[ဂငစဇဒဓနပဖဗမ]
ဂ္[ငစဇဒဓနပဖဗမ]
ဂ္[ကဆဏတထဘယလသဟ]
စ္[ခဂငဇဒဓနပဖဗမ]
စ္[ကဏတထဘယလသဟ]
ဇ္[ခဂငဒဓနပဖဗမ]
ဏ္[ကဃဆတထဘယလသဟ]
ဗ္[ခဂစဇဒဓနပဖမ]
ဗ္[ကဃဆတထယလသ]
မ္[ကဃဆတထယလသဟ]
ရိုက်နှိမ်
